audience.text: Developers needing fast, lightweight image format detection and header metadata for .NET applications without pulling in full imaging libraries.

capabilities.text: Detects 14 image formats by reading file signatures only, returning ImageFormat values without decoding pixels.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: Reads width, height, bit depth, and frame count directly from headers for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, ICO, TIFF, PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF.
capabilities.title: Header metadata extraction

capabilities.text: Counts frames in animated formats: APNG via acTL, WebP via ANMF chunks, GIF via image descriptors, TIFF via IFD chain, and bundled DJVU via FORM:DJVU components.
capabilities.title: Frame counting

capabilities.text: Parses Implicit VR Little Endian and Explicit VR Little/Big Endian DICOM transfer syntaxes, reading Rows, Columns, and BitsAllocated from the dataset.
capabilities.title: DICOM support

capabilities.text: Provides async entry points ProbeAsync and ProbeFileAsync for non-blocking image probing on ASP.NET threads.
capabilities.title: Async probing

capabilities.text: No required third-party package dependencies; all format parsing is implemented natively within the library.
capabilities.title: Zero dependencies

limitations.text: Only performs format detection and header parsing; does not decode, render, edit, or convert pixel data.
Non-placeable WMF is detected but yields no width/height since its header lacks a bounding rectangle.
DICOM parsing stops at the first undefined-length element, such as a sequence or encapsulated pixel data.
FrameCount returns null for DICOM, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF in current implementation.
CDR support is planned but not yet implemented; no CdrFormatHandler exists in the source tree.
Indirect (multi-file) DJVM and truncated bundled DJVU return null for FrameCount.

problems_solved.text: Avoids full image decoding just to determine format and basic properties like dimensions and bit depth.
Provides format detection and header parsing for less common formats like PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF in a single library.
Enables non-blocking image probing via async entry points suitable for ASP.NET request threads.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging.Foss is a zero-dependency .NET library for detecting image formats and reading header metadata without decoding pixels.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported for frame counting is not fully enumerated beyond APNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, and DJVU.
Whether AVIF grid images report tile or full-canvas dimensions depends on presence of ispe, pitm, and ipma associations.
The behavior of Probe on malformed headers for less common formats like DJVU or HEIC is not fully specified beyond returning null for missing fields.
The handling of truncated streams for formats like PSD or EMF is not detailed beyond propagating stream errors.
The exact behavior of DetectFormat on non-seekable streams for formats with variable-length headers is not specified.
The scope of DICOM compressed transfer syntaxes supported is not fully detailed beyond common ones.
The behavior of Probe when encountering multiple undefined-length elements in DICOM is not specified.
The exact conditions under which AVIF is detected via mif1/mif2 major brands are not fully detailed.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Clone the repository, build the solution with dotnet build, and run tests with dotnet test.

workflows.name: CI validation
workflows.text: Continuous integration runs on Ubuntu and Windows using workflows in .github/workflows/.

workflows.name: Release publishing
workflows.text: Tagged pushes trigger .github/workflows/release.yml to build and publish the package.
